preconditions: Owned TargetModel snapshot with original native records; no discovery, approval or external verification provider is fabricated.
steps: Resolve the stored view through native Query/SRX and relation services, compare typed rows/groups and snapshot bindings, and reject unsupported declarations before producing data.

11.k.R: reject unknown/duplicate formats and foreign executable declarations; verify empty-filter validation, static projection paths, graph/type/source boundaries, unchanged original bytes and actual absence of external I/O; compare isolated Core/PYZ data.
11.k.C: extract unchanged declaration planning into a private pure module; keep all W/R tests and public result/error contracts byte-for-byte unchanged.

11.l.R: preserve missing cells explicitly without null/type coercion; evaluate acyclic nested records projections with independent native graph bounds, stable target IDs and original source bindings; reject malformed/unused definitions before filtering.
11.l.C: extract unchanged native scope/configuration/query selection and typed row evaluation into private services; preserve all W/R tests, public bindings, grouping, error contracts and effects.

oracle.requirement_contract: Sortierung und Gruppierung einer View MÜSSEN eine stabile Kollationsregel besitzen.
oracle.scope: 11.k.W: closed unconfigured project view; native SRX filter/sort; artifact-field and bounded distinct-related-ID/count columns; stable scalar grouping and exact snapshot bindings. Read-only data, no rendering or full project validation. R adds closed format names and adversarial declaration/source/graph tests, no-I/O guards and isolated package parity. 11.l.R adds explicit missing preservation and bounded nested record data in the same configured snapshot.

open_items: Live non-project closure, computed-status services and CLI/rendering adapters remain assigned to their actual providers and later steps. These are partial behavior tests, not full-suite or release evidence.
